case.caption: Donald J. Trump v. British Broadcasting Corporation et al.
case.court: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida

claims.proposition: The BBC acknowledged that its documentary edit created a mistaken impression that Donald Trump made a direct call for violent action.
The BBC is legally liable for defamation.
The complaint seeks at least five billion dollars on each of two counts, for a stated total of ten billion dollars.
Financial discovery relating to alleged business and reputational harm was ordered and later contested by Trump through emergency and amendment-related motions.
Trump sought to amend the damages theory to focus more heavily on alleged personal reputational harm while continuing to seek ten billion dollars.
The purpose of the amendment was to shield Trump-linked entities from discovery.
The BBC has already won the case.
In a September 4, 2026 filing, Trump responded to an order to show cause concerning the timing of opposition papers and argued that any delay resulted from compliance with a protective order.
The BBC sought testimony and documents from Donald Trump Jr., Ivanka Trump, and Jared Kushner in connection with discovery.
